Answer: In order to avail the medical reimbursements towards the expenses of hospitalization treatment (IPD), the Institute has chosen a “Pan India Cashless Medical Insurance Scheme (PICMIS)” offered by an Insurer. This is the PICMIS of the Institute. Who are covered under PICMIS? Answer: All the registered regular students are covered under this policy. What is the coverage value/sum insured under PICMIS? Answer: The basic sum insured is Rs. 1,00,000/- per student. Is PICMIS useful for OPD? Answer: Yes. In case, any student is referred to an outside specialist doctor for consultation or a pathology test, the expenditure thereon shall also be eligible for re-imbursement under this policy limited to the cover of Rs. 5000/- for 200 cases. Is there any waiting period? Answer: There is no waiting period for any disease/treatment covered under the PICMIS. Current Policy is effective from 01.08.2022-31.07.2023 . Further, all pre-existing diseases are covered. Is there any upper limit for the reimbursement? Answer: The upper limit is the sum insured (Basic Sum Insured Rs.1,00,000 + buffer subject to the availability to the maximum tune of Rs. 1,00,000/-). To avail the facility of buffer amount procedure may be adopted: If student feels the claim for the particular treatment will exceed the limit of Sum Insured (i.e. Rs. 100000/-) the student may write an email President, Student Gymkhana with cc to This email address is being protected from spambots.
